name: Rosette Masjid
summary: A sculpted, stepped mosque with a carved four-lobed rose window and short flanking minarets.
why: The radial roof, facade and minarets are one connected structure. The window and doorway share x=54. Four substantial circular openings carve the rosette directly from the dome; the colored diamond rests on the solid center rather than floating above the building.
risk: The roof is deliberately ornamental and less literal than a smooth dome. The four large window lobes remain visible at 48 px, while 24 px emphasizes the overall relief shape.
key1: A window carved into the roof
sub1: The rosette is part of the architecture
sub2: Short towers keep the mosque readable
reasonToChoose: A sculpted, stepped mosque with a carved four-lobed rose window and short flanking minarets.
